sources.quote: Our present research aims to create a foundation for mechanistic interpretability research. In particular, we're focused on trying to resolve the challenge of superposition.

input_claims.text: The researcher describes their present research as laying a foundation for mechanistic interpretability by trying to resolve superposition.

sources.quote: It's a bottom up approach, studying small pieces without an a priori theory.

input_claims.text: The researcher describes mechanistic interpretability as a bottom-up approach that studies small parts of neural networks without an a priori theory.

sources.quote: everything in this essay is almost definitionally extremely speculative and uncertain. It's far from clear that any of it will ultimately be possible.

input_claims.text: The researcher characterizes the essay’s vision as subjective and speculative, and says it is unclear whether its aspirations will be possible.

sources.quote: Err on the side of sharing credit. Credit isn’t zero sum. It is often in everyone’s benefit to be generous with credit

input_claims.text: The researcher favors erring on the side of sharing credit and being generous with credit.

sources.quote: Always check in with any person who could plausibly be an author or feel like they should be, even if you disagree. Never have authorship or authorship order be decided behind closed doors or without giving people an opportunity to advocate for themselves.

input_claims.text: The researcher favors checking with anyone who could plausibly be an author and ensuring authorship decisions are not made behind closed doors or without giving people a chance to advocate for themselves.

sources.quote: Write a contributions statement everyone agrees with before discussing author order.

input_claims.text: The researcher recommends writing a contributions statement that everyone agrees with before discussing author order.

principles.text: The researcher describes their present research as laying a foundation for mechanistic interpretability by trying to resolve superposition.
The researcher describes mechanistic interpretability as a bottom-up approach that studies small parts of neural networks without an a priori theory.
The researcher characterizes the essay’s vision as subjective and speculative, and says it is unclear whether its aspirations will be possible.
The researcher favors erring on the side of sharing credit and being generous with credit.

The researcher favors checking with anyone who could plausibly be an author and ensuring authorship decisions are not made behind closed doors or without giving people a chance to advocate for themselves.
The researcher recommends writing a contributions statement that everyone agrees with before discussing author order.
